scope: Local Linux/arm64 certificate lifecycle through the existing mutual-TLS gateway and filtered Docker proxy. Actual Docker version calls; no HTTP stand-in, user credentials, generated workloads or personal VM.
implementation: New explicit host gate and temporary certificate fixture reuse existing example proxy/gateway consumers. Installed proxy/gateway source matches current repository hashes. Product runtime passes unchanged.
verified: An initial valid client/server pair completes an actual Docker version call through the filtered proxy.
An expired client fails and the gateway reports certificate has expired; an expired server fails with the Docker client expiry diagnostic.
A newly issued server leaf under the same CA works after a controlled gateway restart.
During CA rotation, overlapping old/new trust accepts both old and new clients against the new server identity.

After old-CA withdrawal, the new client still works, the old client fails and the gateway reports an untrusted issuer. A client retaining only old server trust rejects the new server with unknown authority.
Gateway/controller lack the raw socket, ownership ledger and initializer CA private keys; runtime certificate files are private. No proxied Docker mutation occurs.
All exact test containers, four selected named volumes and internal network are removed and independently confirmed absent.

fixture.network: Disposable internal network; no published host ports. Trusted filtering proxy network none.
fixture.credentials: New RSA2048 old/new test authorities; explicit expired/valid leaf dates. CA private keys only in initializer tmpfs. Separate client/server leaf-key volumes, mode 0600 files and 0700 directories.
fixture.socket: Only trusted proxy mounts actual daemon socket. Gateway receives only filtered Unix socket; controller only client keys.
fixture.limits: Non-root uid/gid 1001, read-only roots, dropped capabilities, no-new-privileges, memory 512 MiB, 128 processes and 2 CPUs. Proxy alone joins local socket group 0.
fixture.rotation: Stop disposable gateway, change selected files through a volume-scoped helper, restart gateway. No hot reload or already-established session test.
fixture.docker_mutation_scope: The zero-mutation result covers requests proxied over TLS. Host orchestration creates/stops/removes fixture containers and resources as explicitly scoped.

migration: Acceptance-only additions. No product runtime, TLS settings, API payloads, stored schemas, credentials or existing Docker contexts change.
pending: Per-leaf revocation, CRL/OCSP and established-session invalidation; withdrawing a CA is not proof of these behaviors.
Automated certificate issuance/renewal, hot reload and selected production dockerd/proxy TLS provisioning.
Personal VM repetition, daemon/power-loss, real account/device and installed desktop acceptance remain separate.
